main_measure.name: slope of 5-bar excess forward return on forecast (non-overlapping grid, active bars)

statistic.name: OLS slope t, clustered by day

main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope > 0 with t >= 2; reject: slope < 0 with t <= -2 (t clustered by day)

supporting_check.name: deepest minus shallowest third by |forecast|, mean excess 5-bar return (Welch t <= -2)

decided_by: The slope's |t| is below 2 (or undefined): neither confirm nor reject, so inconclusive.
reading: The choppy profile is read as the bars whose recorded regime is 'unknown' (the only regime with a strategy, i.e. 60-bar price evolution between -10 and +10), the situation as a close below its 20-day high (depth < 0) on the short side; the drift is the coin's mean non-overlapping 5-bar return over all its windows' grids, the slope's t is clustered by calendar day (UTC), and thirds are cut by rank of |forecast| over all grid cases.
